courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Aerospace Engineering
courses.summary: The Students Traffic catalogue category for four-year undergraduate aerospace engineering degrees. Programmes in this category cover aerodynamics, flight mechanics, propulsion, aerospace structures, control systems and spacecraft dynamics, supported by wind-tunnel, propulsion and structures laboratories and a final-year design project. In India the award is a B.Tech. or B.E. over eight semesters, and international entry normally requires physics and mathematics at the school-leaving stage.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Aerospace Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Aerospace degrees abroad by four-year structure, subject prerequisites, teaching language, tuition in USD and international entry.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology
courses.summary: The B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology is an undergraduate engineering degree that applies engineering principles to living systems. Students study biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology and genetic engineering alongside bioprocess engineering, fermentation technology, downstream processing, bioinformatics and engineering mathematics, with substantial laboratory work and an industry or research project. It is usually a four-year programme entered after secondary school with physics, chemistry and mathematics or biology. Graduates work in biopharmaceutical, food, agricultural and environmental biotechnology or continue to M.Tech or research study.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Biotechnology degrees open to international students: curriculum, entry subjects, duration, tuition and intakes.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering structural analysis and design, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, surveying and construction management. Programmes pair lecture teaching with materials, hydraulics and surveying laboratories, site visits and a final-year design project. Graduates work in construction, infrastructure, consultancy and public works, or continue to a master's specialisation.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Civil: Course, Fees and Admission
courses.metaDescription: What a four-year B.E./B.Tech Civil degree covers, the entry requirements it carries, how admission is decided and what tuition to plan for.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science
Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate engineering degrees in computer science and engineering, usually four years after an upper-secondary qualification with mathematics. Typical curricula run from programming, data structures, operating systems, databases and computer networks to algorithms, software engineering and electives in artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud and security, with project and internship components.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech CSE Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech CSE degrees for international applicants: duration, teaching language, intake months, tuition and each university's admission route.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers four-year undergraduate degrees in electrical and electronics engineering taken after an upper-secondary qualification with physics and mathematics. Programmes typically cover circuit theory, electrical machines, power systems, power electronics, control systems and embedded electronics, with laboratory work and electives in renewable energy or electric mobility.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech EEE Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech EEE degrees for international applicants: programme length, teaching language, intake months, tuition and admission routes.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Electronics and Communication Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate engineering degrees in electronics and communication engineering, usually four years after upper-secondary physics, chemistry and mathematics. Curricula typically span circuit and network theory, analog and digital electronics, signals and systems, digital signal processing, communication systems and embedded or VLSI design, with laboratory and project work.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech ECE Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech ECE degrees for international applicants: duration, teaching language, intakes, tuition and each university's admission route.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering engineering mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, manufacturing processes and control systems. Teaching is built around workshop practice, thermal and materials laboratories, computer-aided design and a final-year project. Graduates move into manufacturing, automotive, energy, thermal and design roles, or continue to a master's specialisation such as thermal engineering or machine design.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Mechanical: Course, Fees and Admission
courses.metaDescription: What a four-year B.E./B.Tech Mechanical degree covers, its entry requirements, how admission is decided and what tuition and duration to plan for.

courses.name: Master of Business Administration
courses.summary: The MBA is a general management master's degree covering accounting, economics, marketing, finance, operations, human resources and strategy, usually with elective specialisation in the later terms. Duration, entrance-test expectations, work-experience requirements and fees vary widely between schools and countries, so each programme record has to be read on its own terms.
courses.metaTitle: MBA Programmes: Admissions, Fees and Intakes
courses.metaDescription: Compare MBA programmes abroad by entrance-test thresholds, eligibility, duration, teaching language, intake timing, fee state and application steps.

courses.name: Master of Computer Applications
courses.summary: The Master of Computer Applications is a two-year postgraduate degree in applied computing, open to graduates who have studied computing or mathematics at undergraduate level. Study covers advanced programming, algorithms, database management, software engineering, computer networks and web technologies, with electives such as machine learning, cloud computing, data analytics and cyber security, and usually a major project or industry internship. Graduates typically work as software developers, systems analysts or IT consultants, and some continue to doctoral research in computer applications.
courses.metaDescription: Compare MCA programmes open to international students: eligibility, specialisations, project work, duration, tuition and intake timing.

courses.name: M.E./M.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering
aliases: Master of Electronics and Communication Engineering
courses.summary: Compare postgraduate electronics and communication engineering programmes by communication networks, signal processing, electronics, systems design, laboratories, projects, duration, tuition and admissions. The canonical category covers clearly communication-engineering-led awards while preserving each university's official programme title and technical emphasis.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.E./M.Tech ECE programmes abroad by curriculum, tuition, admissions and university.

courses.name: M.E./M.Tech in Energy Engineering
aliases: Master of Technology in Energy Science and Technology
courses.summary: The M.E./M.Tech in Energy Engineering is a postgraduate engineering degree in producing, converting, storing and managing energy. Coursework typically covers thermodynamics and heat transfer, solar, wind and bioenergy systems, energy storage and batteries, power systems and grid integration, energy efficiency and auditing, and energy policy, followed by a research dissertation. It suits graduates in mechanical, electrical or chemical engineering or the physical sciences. The degree normally lasts two years and leads to roles in renewable-energy development, utilities and energy consultancy, or to research.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.E./M.Tech Energy Engineering programmes open to international students: renewable-energy focus, eligibility, duration and tuition.

courses.name: M.E./M.Tech in Environmental Engineering
aliases: Master of Technology in Environmental Engineering
courses.summary: The M.E./M.Tech in Environmental Engineering is a postgraduate engineering degree for graduates in civil, chemical or environmental engineering or a related science. Advanced study covers water and wastewater treatment design, air-quality management, solid and hazardous waste engineering, environmental modelling, impact and risk assessment, and health and safety management, with a research dissertation in the final year. The degree normally lasts two years and leads to roles in environmental consultancy, pollution-control agencies, utilities and industry, or to doctoral research.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.E./M.Tech Environmental Engineering programmes open to international students: eligibility, research areas, duration and tuition.

courses.name: M.E./M.Tech in Materials Engineering
aliases: Master of Technology in Materials Science and Engineering
courses.summary: The M.E./M.Tech in Materials Engineering is a postgraduate engineering degree in the structure, properties, processing and performance of materials. Study covers metals, ceramics, polymers, composites and nanomaterials, materials characterisation, thermodynamics and kinetics, electronic and functional materials, and nanotechnology, with a research dissertation in the final year. It suits graduates in materials, metallurgical, mechanical or chemical engineering, or in physics or chemistry. Programmes normally last two years; integrated five-year versions admit students after secondary school.
courses.metaDescription: Compare M.E./M.Tech Materials Engineering programmes open to international students: eligibility, research areas, duration and tuition.

universities.name: Periyar Maniammai Institute of Science & Technology
universities.summary: Periyar Maniammai Institute of Science & Technology (PMIST) is a private deemed-to-be university at Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu. Its regular degree portfolio spans engineering, computing, management, architecture, science and humanities. Engineering, MBA and MCA entry routes combine programme-specific academic requirements with merit or entrance selection.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Vallam campus covers 114.85 acres. Students can use sports facilities and participate in the National Sports Organization’s physical-fitness, martial-arts, games and sports activities. Periyar Maniammai Hospital operates inside the campus.
universities.cityProfile: PMIST is at Periyar Nagar, Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613403. Its teaching campus is distinct from Periyar University in Salem and from Ponnaiyah Ramajayam Institute of Science & Technology (PRIST), another Thanjavur institution. The university’s online registration route serves applicants to the Vallam campus.
universities.practicalExposure: The postgraduate regulations provide credit-bearing industrial training or internships in two-week slots: two weeks earn one credit, four weeks two credits and six weeks three credits. A continuous placement within one organization and a submitted report form part of the assessment. Up to six weeks of summer industrial training can replace one professional elective under the specified approval process. The Centre for University Industry Interaction coordinates placement, training and university-industry activity.
universities.hostelOverview: Campus accommodation includes Chakravarthy boys’ hostel and Annai Maniammaiyar and Vittobai girls’ hostels. Published accommodation charges include room rent, mess, electricity and maintenance, washing and deposits. The available fee PDF is undated, so obtain the current room allocation and total payable amount before budgeting.
universities.dietarySupport: Hostel mess charges are listed separately from room rent and include meals within the accommodation fee structure. The available schedule does not establish current menus or special-diet provision; discuss dietary requirements before choosing accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The campus has an Anti-Ragging Cell, an Internal Complaints Committee and a student grievance process. The on-campus hospital operates 24 hours with a medical officer and paramedical support.
universities.studentSupport: The Centre for Student Administrative Services handles student grievances, including admission, fee-refund and accommodation concerns. An International Academic Advisor supports international students with programme and campus information. Students Traffic can help review programme fit and application readiness.
whyChoose: Study regular engineering, computing or management degrees at the Vallam campus with English instruction.
Postgraduate regulations provide a credit-bearing industrial training and internship route with assessed reports.
International access is identified by programme rather than assumed across every degree.

The verified class commencement is 22 July 2026 for 2026-27; it does not establish a future application deadline.

Graduates seeking an MBA, MCA or M.Tech with the relevant degree, marks and entrance requirements.

faq.question: Is PMIST private or government?
faq.answer: PMIST is a private deemed-to-be university. The UGC register records its deemed status from 17 August 2007 and locates it at Vallam, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Is PMIST the same as Periyar University?
faq.answer: No. PMIST is at Vallam in Thanjavur. Periyar University is a separate state university in Salem, while PRIST is another distinct institution in Thanjavur.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The regular B.Tech regulations specify English. The 2024 postgraduate regulations use English instruction and permit bilingual English/Tamil examinations; MA Tamil follows a separate Tamil-medium rule.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: The 2026-27 approval identifies international access programme by programme. Some programmes have international approval while others do not; a university-wide international policy should not be used to assume access to every degree.

faq.question: What subjects are needed for B.Tech?
faq.answer: Aerospace, Civil and Mechanical Engineering require Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Biotechnology requires Physics and Chemistry with Biology, Biotechnology or Mathematics; CSE, ECE and EEE require Physics and Mathematics plus an approved additional subject.

faq.question: What is the MBA entry requirement?
faq.answer: Applicants need a bachelor’s degree of at least three years with 50% marks, or 45% for a reserved category. A qualifying PMIST, TANCET, MAT, CAT or equivalent entrance result is required for the dual-specialisation MBA.

faq.question: How do students apply?
faq.answer: Use PMIST’s online registration page and select the intended programme. Complete the academic details, follow the relevant merit or entrance route and present the required qualification and admission-category records.

faq.question: When does the academic year begin?
faq.answer: The signed schedule gives 22 July 2026 as commencement for 2026-27. That date describes the verified academic cycle; it is not an application deadline or a confirmed future intake date.

faq.question: How much should students budget?
faq.answer: Request a current, category-specific quotation covering tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation and meals. The public programme-fee table gives total first-year charges without a clear academic year or tuition-only breakdown, so it is not used as a confirmed tuition price.

faq.question: Does PMIST have hostels?
faq.answer: Chakravarthy boys’ hostel and the girls’ hostels provide campus accommodation. Charges include room rent, mess and other service components; confirm current availability, deposits and fees before accepting a room.

faq.question: Is practical training part of postgraduate study?
faq.answer: The postgraduate regulations provide credit for industrial training and internships in two-week slots. Students complete continuous training in an organization, submit a report and follow departmental evaluation and approval requirements.

evidence.claimText: Vallam campus 114.85 acres; National Sports Organization physical fitness, martial arts and sports; 24x7 20-bed hospital with medical officer and paramedical staff.

The postgraduate regulations provide credit-bearing industrial training or internships in two-week slots: two weeks earn one credit, four weeks two credits and six weeks three credits. A continuous placement within one organization and a submitted report form part of the assessment. Up to six weeks of summer industrial training can replace one professional elective under the specified approval process. The Centre for University Industry Interaction coordinates placement, training and university-industry activity.
